extDescription.message: Warns you when a PDF you add to an allowed website contains secrets.

skeletonBatchTitle.description: Walking-skeleton notification title; replaced by the result notifications in step 7.

skeletonBatchMessage.message: Received $COUNT$ file(s) from $SITE$. Results are not shown in notifications yet.

titleSecretsOne.description: Notification title: one file of the batch contains secrets.

titleSecretsMany.description: Notification title: several files were added at once and some contain secrets.

titleFailedOne.description: Notification title: a file could not be checked, or only partly (no secret found in what was checked).

titleFailedMany.description: Notification title: several files, some could not be checked fully (no secrets found).

titleUnauthorized.description: Notification title: the API rejected the APP-ID.

titleNotConfigured.message: PDF Secret Scanner isn't set up
titleNotConfigured.description: Notification title: no APP-ID entered yet.

titleInterrupted.description: Notification title: the scan stopped before a result (offscreen document gone).

secretsAddedOne.description: Start of the secrets message (one file).

secretsAddedMany.description: Start of the secrets message (several files).

findingWithPages.description: One finding: entity type, page numbers, masked value.

findingNoPages.description: One finding whose page is not known.

secretsAdvice.message: Remove the file and rotate the credentials.

partsNotScanned.message: $COUNT$ of $TOTAL$ parts could not be scanned.
partsNotScanned.description: Added to a result when some chunks failed.

fileReason.description: One line per file in a several-files message.

reason.example: The PDF is password-protected – it was not checked.

notConfiguredMessage.description: Message of the not-configured notification; clicking opens the settings.

error_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: PDF Secret Scanner has no APP-ID yet – the file was not checked.
error_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: Reason shown for error code NOT_CONFIGURED.

error_FILE_TOO_LARGE.message: The file is larger than the size limit – it was not checked.
error_FILE_TOO_LARGE.description: Reason shown for error code FILE_TOO_LARGE.

error_PDF_ENCRYPTED.message: The PDF is password-protected – it was not checked.
error_PDF_ENCRYPTED.description: Reason shown for error code PDF_ENCRYPTED.

error_PDF_INVALID.message: The PDF could not be read – it was not checked.
error_PDF_INVALID.description: Reason shown for error code PDF_INVALID.

error_NO_TEXT_LAYER.message: The PDF has no text (for example a scan) – it was not checked.
error_NO_TEXT_LAYER.description: Reason shown for error code NO_TEXT_LAYER.

error_API_UNREACHABLE.message: The scanning service could not be reached – the file was not checked.
error_API_UNREACHABLE.description: Reason shown for error code API_UNREACHABLE.

error_API_TIMEOUT.message: The scanning service did not answer in time – the file was not fully checked.
error_API_TIMEOUT.description: Reason shown for error code API_TIMEOUT.

error_API_HTTP_ERROR.message: The scanning service returned an error – the file was not fully checked.
error_API_HTTP_ERROR.description: Reason shown for error code API_HTTP_ERROR.

error_API_BAD_RESPONSE.message: The scanning service gave an unexpected answer – the file was not fully checked.
error_API_BAD_RESPONSE.description: Reason shown for error code API_BAD_RESPONSE.

error_API_UNAUTHORIZED.message: Your APP-ID was rejected – check the extension settings.
error_API_UNAUTHORIZED.description: Reason shown for error code API_UNAUTHORIZED.

error_SCAN_INTERRUPTED.message: The scan was interrupted – the file was not checked.
error_SCAN_INTERRUPTED.description: Reason shown for error code SCAN_INTERRUPTED.

error_SCAN_TIMEOUT.message: The scan took too long and was stopped – the file was not fully checked.
error_SCAN_TIMEOUT.description: Reason shown for error code SCAN_TIMEOUT.

error_TEXT_TRUNCATED.message: Only the first $SCANNED$ of $TOTAL$ characters were checked.
error_TEXT_TRUNCATED.description: Reason shown for error code TEXT_TRUNCATED.

error_CHUNK_TOO_LARGE.message: Part of the text could not be scanned.
error_CHUNK_TOO_LARGE.description: Reason shown for error code CHUNK_TOO_LARGE.

error_QUEUE_FULL.message: Too many files at once – this file was not checked. Try again in a moment.
error_QUEUE_FULL.description: Reason shown for error code QUEUE_FULL.
